entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: A mercurial faerie rogue of Eldraine's Wilds known for cruel pranks.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Queen of Locthwain, whom Rankle resolved to marry; she was compleated.

entities.name: Torbran
entities.description: Dwarf who rescued Rankle and traveled to Locthwain with a ring of three wishes.

entities.name: Orla
entities.description: Fairy subject of Rankle's whose mouth he put bees in.

entities.name: Fifer
entities.description: Fairy whose mouth Rankle sewed shut.

entities.name: Mags
entities.description: Fairy who never got along with Rankle.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: Kingdom ruled by Ayara, compleated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Phyrexian invasion of Eldraine, spreading compleation.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders lured into a chasm by Rankle's love potion rain.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: Curse that overtook the Phyrexians and Rankle.

events.summary: Rankle is expelled from his glade by his fairy subjects, who hate him, and loses part of a wing.
events.quote: Rankle was instead kicked out of his glade.

events.summary: Rankle meets Ayara and resolves to be her next husband, seeking a love potion.
events.quote: He resolved to be her next husband and set off to find a love potion.

events.summary: A mechanical dog of the New Phyrexian Invasion attacks Rankle and Torbran rescues him.
events.quote: He was rescued by Torbran , who was traveling to Locthwain.

events.summary: In Locthwain, Rankle finds Ayara compleated and steals Torbran's ring of three wishes.
events.quote: Unfazed, he stole Torbran's ring of three wishes

events.summary: Rankle's third wish rains love potion; the Phyrexians pursue him and fall into the chasm as the Wicked Slumber overtakes them.
events.quote: all the Phyrexians, affected by the love potion, pursued Rankle and fell into the chasm, just as the Wicked Slumber overtook them

events.summary: After the curse is broken, Rankle wakes and returns to pranks.
events.quote: After the curse was broken, Rankle awoke and quickly returned to playing pranks.

relations.quote: He resolved to be her next husband
